verdict.rationale: GitLab ships AI features (GitLab Duo, model selection, agents), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Mentions of permissions, audit trails, and self-hosting are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
